name: Cyprazepam
summary: Cyprazepam is a drug which is a sedative-hypnotic benzodiazepine derivative. It has anxiolytic properties, and presumably also has hypnotic, skeletal muscle relaxant, anticonvulsant and amnestic properties.

pharmacology.text: It has anxiolytic properties, and presumably also has hypnotic, skeletal muscle relaxant, anticonvulsant and amnestic properties.

summaryZh: 環丙西泮（英語：Cyprazepam）是一種鎮靜催眠苯二氮䓬衍生物藥物。它具有抗焦慮特性，並且可能還具有催眠、骨骼肌鬆弛、抗驚厥和遺忘特性。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the benzodiazepines, can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal including seizures, and in overdose can slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的苯二氮平類藥物可能造成嗜睡、協調變差與記憶問題，可能導致依賴，戒斷時可能出現包括癲癇發作在內的危險症狀，過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的苯二氮平类药物可能造成嗜睡、协调制差与记忆问题，可能导致依赖，戒断时可能出现包括癫痫发作在内的危险症状，过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Like chlordiazepoxide, the first benzodiazepine, it carries an N-oxide: an oxygen atom attached directly to one of its ring nitrogens.
fact.zh: 和第一個苯二氮平類藥物氯氮䓬一樣，它帶有 N-氧化物，也就是一個直接接在環上氮原子的氧原子。
fact.zhHans: 和第一个苯二氮平类药物氯氮䓬一样，它带有 N-氧化物，也就是一个直接接在环上氮原子的氧原子。
